# Musicore

> Musicore is a professional music school based in Dubai, UAE, offering one-on-one home music lessons and online music lessons. We teach Guitar, Piano, Drums, Violin, and Vocals to students of all ages and skill levels across Dubai.

## About Musicore

Musicore is a Dubai-based music education company. Our teachers come directly to students' homes across Dubai, or teach online via video call. We serve all major Dubai areas including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, JBR, Jumeirah, Business Bay, DIFC, Mirdif, Deira, Palm Jumeirah, and Arabian Ranches.

We offer flexible lesson durations (30, 45, or 60 minutes) and flexible plans (single sessions, monthly 4-session packs, bi-monthly 8-session packs, quarterly 12-session packs, and semi-annual 24-session packs).

## Services

- Guitar Lessons in Dubai (home and online)
- Piano Lessons in Dubai (home and online)
- Drums Lessons in Dubai (home and online)
- Violin Lessons in Dubai (home and online)
- Vocal / Singing Lessons in Dubai (home and online)
- Online Music Lessons UAE (all instruments)
- Kids Music Lessons Dubai (ages 5 and up)
- Adult Music Lessons Dubai (all levels)

## Teachers

Musicore's teachers are qualified, vetted professionals with years of performance and teaching experience. Each teacher specialises in one or more instruments and adapts lessons to the individual learner.

## Pricing

- Single session: AED 150–230 depending on duration
- Monthly plan (4 sessions): AED 800–920
- Quarterly plan (12 sessions): AED 2,700
- Online sessions: starting from AED 80 per session

## Booking

Lessons are booked directly on the website at https://musicoreuae.com. After booking, a WhatsApp group is created with the student, teacher, and Musicore team to coordinate scheduling and lesson notes.

## FAQ

**Do you offer online lessons?**
Yes. We offer both online (via video call) and one-on-one home lessons anywhere in Dubai.

**What areas in Dubai do you cover?**
We cover all major areas including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, JBR, Jumeirah, Business Bay, DIFC, Mirdif, Deira, and more.

**What age groups do you teach?**
We teach all ages, from 5-year-olds to adults. Teachers adapt lessons to the learner.

**Do I need to own an instrument?**
For guitar and piano, having one at home is recommended. For drums, we bring a portable electronic kit for the first few lessons.

**What is the cancellation policy?**
Cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before a session at no charge.
